question: Which visa applicants have to submit a tuberculosis test certificate at a Korean diplomatic mission?
reference: Nationals of high TB-burden countries who live in one of those countries and apply for a long-term visa (stay of 91 days or longer) at a diplomatic mission.
answer: Nationals of high TB-burden countries must submit a tuberculosis test certificate when applying for a long-term visa (stay period of 91 days or longer) at a Korean diplomatic mission [2]. The same submission rule applies to e-visa applicants who attach the certificate as a supporting document [3].

 - Long-term visa (granted on March 1, 2016 or before) holders: when 
applying for alien registration
 ② If you entered Korea on March 1, 2016 or before
 - Short-term visa holders: when applying for change of status or 
extension of stay period to a long-term status
 - Long-term visa holders: when applying for change of status, extension 
of stay period or alien registration for the first time

or before, you still have to submit the certificate to extend your stay 
period)
 - Marriage Migrant (F-6), spouse of a permanent resident (F-2-3), or 
other visa holders who already submitted the certificate including TB 
test result to acquired the status (granted on March 2, 2016 or after) 
and apply for extension of stay period, etc. 
 - Short-term status holders who apply for extension of stay period
3. What to Submit
 1) (Visa application to a diplomatic mission) A “Certificate of Health” 
including TB test result (Attachment 1, valid for one year) issued by a 
hospital designated by Korean diplomatic missions
 * A certificate of health issued by a designated hospital that includes at 
least one of the following tests result: chest X-ray, sputum test, tuberculin 
skin test, blood test, etc.
 2) (Change of status of stay, alien registration, extension of stay period) A 
certificate of confirmation issued by a Korean public health center
(Attachment 2)

reference: Yes. Children aged 5 and under are exempt.
answer: Yes, children aged 5 and under are exempt from submitting the TB test certificate. [1]

question: Is Uzbekistan one of the high TB-burden countries?
reference: Yes. Uzbekistan is on the list of 18 high TB-burden countries.
answer: Yes, Uzbekistan is listed as a high TB-burden country in the exceptions for submitting a Tuberculosis test certificate [1].

by short-term foreign residents
Visit Hi Korea website (www.hikorea.go.kr) or a dedicated website set up for this scheme (www.k-eta.go.kr/trds) for more information. 
This schemes aims to minimise social/economic loss and ensure safety of the public
by locating short-term residents' accommodation in a timely manner 
should a communicable disease outbreak or a terrorist attack takes place.
* Alerts are classified into four levels, namely: attention, caution, alert, and serious.
Declaration is required in the issuance of a crisis alert* of the "interest" level or higher 
in line with "Infectious Disease Control And Prevention Act" or
in the issuance of a crisis alert* of the "caution" level of higher 
in line with "Act On Counter-terrorism For The Protection Of Citizens And Public Security".
Foreign residents holding short-term visas- B-1(Visa exempted), B-2(Tourism/transit),
C-1(Short-term news coverage), C-3(Short-term visit), C-4(Short-term employment)
should present passport or a travel document to the owner of the accommodation facility.

Accommodation facilities registed as a lodging business in line with Public Health Control Act or
tourist accommodation business, city home-stay services for foreign tourists or Hanok experience business 
in line with Tourism Promotion Act should relay information of foreign guest (e.g. passport information)
via an information network designated by the Ministry of Justice.
A breach of this requirement will result in a fine up to KRW 500,000.

as a measure to prevent the spread of communicable disease

question: Who issues the TB certificate for someone already in Korea who applies for a change of status of stay, and how is that different from a visa application abroad?
reference: In Korea (change of status, alien registration, extension) it is a certificate of confirmation issued by a Korean public health center; for a visa application at a mission it is a Certificate of Health from a hospital designated by the Korean diplomatic mission.
answer: For someone already in Korea applying for a change of status of stay, the TB certificate is issued by a Korean public health center [1]. This differs from a visa application abroad, where the certificate must be issued by a hospital designated by Korean diplomatic missions [1].

question: im chinese but i live in the US, do i need the tb paper for a long term korean visa?
reference: No. Chinese nationals living in the U.S. are not required to submit it; only those living in a high TB-burden country are.
answer: No, you do not need the TB test certificate for a long-term Korean visa. According to passage [1], nationals of high TB-burden countries living in the U.S. are exempt from submitting the TB test certificate when applying for a long-term visa at a diplomatic mission.

question: Do registered foreign residents need a re-entry permit to return to Korea within one year?
reference: No. Registered foreign residents departing after April 1, 2022 can re-enter within 1 year of departure without a re-entry permit (2 years for permanent residents).
answer: No, registered foreign residents departing after April 1, 2022 are allowed re-entry into the ROK within one year without obtaining a Re-entry Permit in advance [1].

citations.title: Announcement Regarding Re-Entry Permit(Reimplementation of Re-Entry Permit Exemption as of April 1, 2022 after suspension due to COVID-19)
citations.snippet:
- 1 -
Announcement Regarding Re-Entry Permit
Reimplementation of Re-Entry Permit Exemption 
as of April 1, 2022 after suspension due to COVID-19
 The Re-Entry Permit Exemption which has been suspended since 
June 1, 2020 will be reimplemented as of April 1, 2022 according to 
changes in COVID response in the nation. 
◎ With the re-implementation of the nation’s Re-Entry Permit Exemption, 
registered foreign residents departing after April 1, 2022 will be allowed 
re-entry into the ROK within 1 year (2 years for permanent residents) 
from the date of departure, without obtaining a Re-entry Permit in 
advance. 
◎ Yet, registered foreign residents intending to re-enter the Republic of 
Korea after spending more than a year abroad from the date of 
departure should apply for a Multiple Re-entry Permit (granted for up to 
2 years)
◎ Registered foreigners who have departed before April 1, 2022 with a 
Re-entry Permit should enter the ROK within the granted re-entry 
permit period (within l year), and should visit a Korean diplomatic mission 
abroad to extend the re-entry permit period in case entering the ROK 
within the relevant period is difficult due to COVID-19. 
1. Persons Exempted from Re-entry Permit ▢ Those Exempted from Re-entry Permit ❍ (Registered Foreigners) Diplomat (A-1) through International Agreement 
(A-3), Korean Arts and Culture (D-1) through Dependent Family 
(F-3), Marriage Migrant (F-6) through Work and Visit (H-2) status 
holders for Re-entry into the ROK within 1 year from the date of 
departure

passages.snippet:
- 1 -
Announcement Regarding Re-Entry Permit
Reimplementation of Re-Entry Permit Exemption 
as of April 1, 2022 after suspension due to COVID-19
 The Re-Entry Permit Exemption which has been suspended since 
June 1, 2020 will be reimplemented as of April 1, 2022 according to 
changes in COVID response in the nation. 
◎ With the re-implementation of the nation’s Re-Entry Permit Exemption, 
registered foreign residents departing after April 1, 2022 will be allowed 
re-entry into the ROK within 1 year (2 years for permanent residents) 
from the date of departure, without obtaining a Re-entry Permit in 
advance. 
◎ Yet, registered foreign residents intending to re-enter the Republic of 
Korea after spending more than a year abroad from the date of 
departure should apply for a Multiple Re-entry Permit (granted for up to 
2 years)
◎ Registered foreigners who have departed before April 1, 2022 with a 
Re-entry Permit should enter the ROK within the granted re-entry 
permit period (within l year), and should visit a Korean diplomatic mission 
abroad to extend the re-entry permit period in case entering the ROK 
within the relevant period is difficult due to COVID-19. 
1. Persons Exempted from Re-entry Permit ▢ Those Exempted from Re-entry Permit ❍ (Registered Foreigners) Diplomat (A-1) through International Agreement 
(A-3), Korean Arts and Culture (D-1) through Dependent Family 
(F-3), Marriage Migrant (F-6) through Work and Visit (H-2) status 
holders for Re-entry into the ROK within 1 year from the date of 
departure

passages.title: Announcement on Changes in Re-entry Permit System
passages.file_name: Announcement on Changes in Re-entry Permit System.pdf
passages.snippet:
【 Announcement on Changes 
in Re-entry Permit System 】
This is to announce that Re-entry Permit System will change as 
specified below as all entrants from overseas are required to submit a 
negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate starting January 8 (Fri.), 
2021 in response to recent spread of the highly transmissible new 
coronavirus strains. 
□ Mandatory submission of negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate 
by foreigners issued with Re-entry Permit
• (Current) Foreigners re-entering the ROK with a Re-entry Permit are 
required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR certificate, a medical 
certificate, or a medical examination exemption certificate. 
• (After the Change) Foreigners re-entering the ROK with a Re-entry 
Permit are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test 
certificate.
 - A negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate is deemed valid only when 
issued within 72 hours prior to departure.
 ※ Application for ‘Medical Examination Exemption Certificate’ for 
Re-entry Permit is no longer available.
□ Date of Enforcement
• All foreigners entering the ROK are required to submit a negative 
COVID-19 PCR test certificate as of 00:00 January 8 (Fri.), 2021.
 - Foreigners with a Re-entry Permit (including those exempted from 
medical examination) issued before January 8 (Fri.), 2021 are also 
required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate if 
entering the nation after 00:00 January 8 (Fri.), 2021.

passages.title: Visa guide: C-3-1 Short-Term General
passages.snippet:
□ You are eligible to apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 1 year,
if you have visited the ROK or any OECD member country for one time and with no criminal and illegal immigration records
□ You are eligible to apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 3 years, if you are
1) A professional that requires a license recognized by a government such as doctor, lawyer, accountant, and others.
2) A faculty member positioned higher than an assistant professor at university (or vocational college), a teacher of elementary, middle, or high school
3) Well-known artists, entertainers and athletes acknowledged by the head of Korean diplomatic mission abroad
4) A person who has visited ROK as a group-tourist guide at a travel agency specialized in group tourists
* It refers to a tourist guide at a travel agency specialized in only assisting group tourists assembled by a designated travel agency only in contrast to a tourist guide of a group tourist agency in general.
5) A person who has visited the ROK or OECD member countries more than two times and has no criminal or illegal immigration records. (*Entry based on visa exemption or as a group tourist to Jeju is NOT counted as the number of visit to ROK)
6) A person who has visited the ROK with a Medical Tourist visa
7) A person who has proved his/her assets including real estate, financial assets, or business ownership worth more than 5,000,000 yuan

【 Announcement on Changes 
in Re-entry Permit System 】
This is to announce that Re-entry Permit System will change as 
specified below as all entrants from overseas are required to submit a 
negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate starting January 8 (Fri.), 
2021 in response to recent spread of the highly transmissible new 
coronavirus strains. 
□ Mandatory submission of negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate 
by foreigners issued with Re-entry Permit
• (Current) Foreigners re-entering the ROK with a Re-entry Permit are 
required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR certificate, a medical 
certificate, or a medical examination exemption certificate. 
• (After the Change) Foreigners re-entering the ROK with a Re-entry 
Permit are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test 
certificate.
 - A negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate is deemed valid only when 
issued within 72 hours prior to departure.
 ※ Application for ‘Medical Examination Exemption Certificate’ for 
Re-entry Permit is no longer available.
□ Date of Enforcement
• All foreigners entering the ROK are required to submit a negative 
COVID-19 PCR test certificate as of 00:00 January 8 (Fri.), 2021.
 - Foreigners with a Re-entry Permit (including those exempted from 
medical examination) issued before January 8 (Fri.), 2021 are also 
required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate if 
entering the nation after 00:00 January 8 (Fri.), 2021.

question: Nationals of which countries are exempt from the re-entry permit fee?
reference: Argentina (aged 14 or under only), Taiwan and Tunisia.
answer: Nationals from Argentina (aged 14 years or less), Taiwan, and Tunisia are exempt from the re-entry permit fee [5]. Scholarship students invited by government such as Korean Arts and Culture (D-1), Student (D-2), General Trainee (D-4) status holders who have submitted a certificate of scholarship or those with exemption request from the relevant organization are also exempt [5]. Additionally, Diplomat (A-1), Foreign Government Official (A-2), International Agreement (A-3), and Corporate Investor (D-8) Status holders are exempt [5].

citations.title: Introducing declaration of accommodation by short-term foreign residents
citations.snippet:
Declaration of accommodation
by short-term foreign residents
Visit Hi Korea website (www.hikorea.go.kr) or a dedicated website set up for this scheme (www.k-eta.go.kr/trds) for more information. 
This schemes aims to minimise social/economic loss and ensure safety of the public
by locating short-term residents' accommodation in a timely manner 
should a communicable disease outbreak or a terrorist attack takes place.
* Alerts are classified into four levels, namely: attention, caution, alert, and serious.
Declaration is required in the issuance of a crisis alert* of the "interest" level or higher 
in line with "Infectious Disease Control And Prevention Act" or
in the issuance of a crisis alert* of the "caution" level of higher 
in line with "Act On Counter-terrorism For The Protection Of Citizens And Public Security".
Foreign residents holding short-term visas- B-1(Visa exempted), B-2(Tourism/transit),
C-1(Short-term news coverage), C-3(Short-term visit), C-4(Short-term employment)
should present passport or a travel document to the owner of the accommodation facility.
A breach of this requirement will result in a fine up to KRW 500,000.
Accommodation facilities registed as a lodging business in line with Public Health Control Act or
tourist accommodation business, city home-stay services for foreign tourists or Hanok experience business 
in line with Tourism Promotion Act should relay information of foreign guest (e.g. passport information)
via an information network designated by the Ministry of Justice.
A breach of this requirement will result in a fine up to KRW 500,000.
went into force as of 10 December 2020
as a measure to prevent the spread of communicable disease
in the country

question: Which short-term visa types are covered by the accommodation declaration rule?
reference: B-1 (visa exempted), B-2 (tourism/transit), C-1, C-3 and C-4.
answer: The accommodation declaration rule covers short-term visa holders holding B-1, B-2, C-1, C-3, and C-4 visas [1]. This list includes B-1 (visa exempted), B-2 (tourism/transit), C-1 (short-term news coverage), C-3 (short-term visit), and C-4 (short-term employment) [1].

question: After April 13, 2020, could citizens of the United Kingdom still enter Korea without a visa?
reference: Yes. The United Kingdom is among the 10 visa-waiver countries still eligible.
answer: Yes, citizens of the United Kingdom could enter Korea without a visa after April 13, 2020. [6] The United Kingdom is listed among the countries eligible for visa-free entry following that date. [6] Citizens of the UK are allowed to stay in Korea for up to 90 days under this program. [3]

passages.title: Visa guide: B-2-1 Tourist / Transit (General)
passages.snippet:
-
Persons who hold a visa (re-entry permit, permanent residency, etc.) to enter the United States, Canada, Australia, or New Zealand (hereinafter referred to as “the four advanced countries”) and
-
1) who go to one of the four advanced countries in transit through Korea; or
-
2) who stay in one of the four advanced countries and take a direct flight from the country to Korea to go to a country of nationality or a third country.
-
Please be noted that:
-
- If you are a U.S. visa holder who transit through Korea and Saipan to reach the U.S. as the final destination, you are permitted to enter Korea without a visa. (However, if you depart from the U.S. and enter Korea via Saipan, you are not granted no-visa entry to Korea.)
-
- If you are a Chinese group tourist holding a group-tourist visa to Japan and meet certain requirements (e.g. using a travel agency that only attracts Chinese group tourists), you are permitted to enter Korea without a visa.
-
- If you hold an e-visa to Australia and a visa label is attached to your passport, you are permitted to enter Korea without a visa. However, if the label is not on your passport, you are granted no-visa entry only when you depart from Australia and transit through Korea.

question: Was visa-free entry for Canadians suspended in 2020?
reference: Yes. Canada is listed among the 34 visa-free countries/regions whose visa-free entry was suspended.
answer: Yes, visa-free entry for Canadians was suspended in 2020. Canada is listed as one of the 34 countries eligible for visa-free entry that had its program temporarily suspended as of April 13, 2020 [1]. Consequently, persons with a Canadian passport are required to obtain a visa from a Korean diplomatic mission to enter the Republic of Korea [2].

question: When was visa-free entry to Jeju suspended, and for whom?
reference: From February 4, 2020, for all foreign nationals.
answer: Visa-free entry to Jeju Special Self-governing Province was temporarily suspended starting on February 4, 2020 [1]. This suspension applies to all foreign nationals who are citizens of nations ineligible for visa-free entry to Jeju [1]. Citizens of nations required to obtain permission for extension of sojourn areas (62 countries) were only exempt from this suspension if they entered the Republic of Korea before the announcement went into effect [1].

question: From what date did all Korean embassies stop issuing visa labels?
reference: July 1, 2020 (embassies in the US, Japan and 24 European countries stopped on February 24, 2020).
answer: All Korean embassies stopped issuing visa labels on July 1st, 2020 [1].

citations.title: Announcement of Label Free Visa Policy and Important Guidelines
citations.file_name: Announcement of Label Free Visa Policy and Important Guidelines.pdf
citations.snippet:
Announcement of Label Free Visa Policy and Important Guidelines
The Korean Embassies in the United States of America, Japan and 24 European Countries* no 
longer issue visa labels, as of 24th February, 2020.
* Europe (24 countries): Greece, Netherlands, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Romania, Belgium, 
Bulgaria, Serbia, Sweden, Switzerland, Spain, Slovakia, Ireland, United Kingdom, Austria, Italy, Czech 
Republic, Croatia, Portugal, Poland, France, Finland, Hungary
※ All Korean Embassies will stop issuing visa labels from 1st July, 2020.
When visa applications are approved, the Embassy will notify applicants of their visa details by 
issuing ‘Visa Grant Notice’. (Visa Application Center may issue the document on behalf of the 
Embassy). All applicants can print out the document at any time, by entering passport information 
(passport number, name and date of birth).
‘Visa Grant Notice’ document can be used to prove visa status, whether he/she is a holder of a 
valid Korean visa. Also, all visa holders are required to present the document to immigration officers 
during immigration clearance.
The document is valid printed either in color, or in black and white. Please refer to the ‘Note’ in the 
document for detailed information.
【How to verify and print out ‘Visa Grant Notice’】
1) Go to www.visa.go.kr - Application Status/Issue - Click ‘Check Application Status & Print’ menu. 2) Enter your Passport number, Name and Date of Birth, and Click the ‘Search’ button. 3) If your visa application is approved, the ‘Certificate’ button will be activated. 4) Click the button and print out the ‘Visa Grant Notice’.
* Please refer to attached file for more details.

question: What administrative sanctions can be imposed on a group e-visa application agency?
reference: Cancellation of designation, suspension of agency operation (1, 2, 3 or 6 months), and a warning.
answer: The administrative sanctions that can be imposed on a group e-Visa application agency are cancellation of designation, suspension of agency operation for 1, 2, 3, or 6 months, and warning [1]. These sanctions may include cancellation of designation where the number of illegal stayers is 11 or more or the rate is 3% or more [3]. Suspension periods range from 1 to 6 months depending on the number of illegal stayers (3 to 4 up to 9 to 10) and the rate of illegal stay (0.4% to less than 1.0% up to 2.0% to less than 3.0%) [3].

citations.title: Regulation on Management of Group e-Visa Application Agency
citations.file_name: Regulation on Management of Group e-Visa Application Agency.pdf
citations.snippet:
① Types of administrative sanctions against a group e-Visa application agency are as follows.
1. Cancellation of designation
2. Suspension of agency operation (1 month, 2 months, 3 months, 6 months)
3. Warning
② The head of Seoul Immigration Office may make a disposition of an administrative sanction referred to in paragraph (1) against a group e-Visa application agency under attached Table 1 of detailed standards for administrative sanctions.
③ The head of Seoul Immigration Office may, prior to making a disposition of an administrative sanction, hear the explanation of a relevant group e-Visa application agency, and may add or reduce the disposition of administrative sanctions considering the explanations.
④ The head of Seoul Immigration Office may temporarily suspend the agency operation of a group e-Visa application agency if it falls under any of the following subparagraphs.
1. Where fact investigation is necessary due to serious violations of the obligations.
2. Where the number of illegal stayers exceeds 5 during 1 month period ,or 3
for each tour group.
3. Where administrative sanctions are made against agency operations, including landing permission for tourism, no-visa entry permission for transit entry, etc.
2. ⑤ The head of Seoul Immigration Office shall, when a disposition of an administrative sanction under paragraph (1) and (2) is concluded, send the Notification of Administrative Sanctions of attached Table 2 to the relevant application agency. The notification shall be done by any of the following methods of electronic mail, fax, or posting it on the Visa Portal.
3. ⑥ The decision of an administrative sanction under paragraph (2) shall be managed by entering it into the IVIS, or the KVIS.

efficiently and systematically by prescribing the detailed provisions, including 
designation, supervision, and administrative sanctions, etc. in relation to a

Portal’)” means an internet portal site (www.visa.go.kr) that supports online 
applications for visa issuance, etc. and provides related useful information.

Article 3 
(Designation of a Group e-Visa Application Agency)
① Where a group visa application agency applies for a designation as a group 
e-Visa application agency, the head of an overseas diplomatic mission shall 
request for the designation thereof to the head of Seoul Immigration Office 
(Head of E-Visa Center) by entering the relevant information1) of the application 
agency into the Integrated Visa Information System (IVIS) with the related 
documents2) attached. In this case, access authorization to the Visa Portal (ID, 
Password) shall be requested as well.
② An application agency which has its designation revoked under this 
regulation shall be allowed to apply, as prescribed in paragraph (1), in two 
full years from the revocation.
③ The Head of Seoul Immigration Office shall notify whether the designation 
is approved to the head of an overseas diplomatic mission through the KVIS 
after conducting a review of the designation request under paragraph (1). 
④ The head of an overseas diplomatic mission shall notify the relevant 
application agency whether the designation as a group e-Visa application 
agency is approved, and shall announce the fact by an appropriate means, 
including posting the fact on the Internet homepage of the mission, etc. 
1) Relevant Information: Required (travel agency name, certificate number of China National 
Tourism Administration, business license number, personal information of representative, contact 
number and address), personal information and contact number of staff in charge, administrative 
sanctions (grounds, disposition, period, disposition authority, etc.), etc. 
2) Relevant Document: For China, certificate of permission for travel agency operation ,business 
license (Equivalent documents for Southeast Asian region)

question: When can the Seoul Immigration Office temporarily suspend a group e-visa agency because of illegal stayers?
reference: When the number of illegal stayers exceeds 5 in one month, or 3 for each tour group.
answer: The Seoul Immigration Office may temporarily suspend a group e-Visa application agency's operation if the number of illegal stayers exceeds 5 during a 1-month period or 3 for each tour group [1].

question: Who can get a 10-year multiple-entry C-3 visa under the 2018 New Southern Policy measure?
reference: Professionals such as doctors, lawyers and professors, and holders of a bachelor's or higher degree from Korea or a master's or higher from overseas, from the listed New Southern Policy countries.
answer: Nationals of Myanmar, Cambodia, Sri Lanka, Indonesia, Laos, Nepal, Pakistan, the Philippines, Vietnam, India, and Bangladesh who are required to obtain a visa for entry into the ROK can get a 10-year multiple-entry C-3 visa [1]. Professionals such as doctors, lawyers, professors, CEOs of public/private enterprises, and those with a bachelor's degree from Korea or a master's degree or higher from overseas are eligible [3]. Residents of large cities in Vietnam with high income are granted a 5-year visa, not a 10-year one [2].

citations.title: (Press Release) Visa Fee Waiver Policy for Group Tourists during the“2016 Visit Korea Year”
citations.file_name: 151221 PRESS RELEASE(Visa Fee Waiver Policy for Group Tourists).pdf
citations.snippet:
- 1 -
❍ The Ministry of Justice of the Republic of Korea extends the current 
visa fee waiver policy for group tourists through to the end of next 
year by reflecting the opinions of the tourism industry and relevant 
authorities.
 Note: The Ministry has implemented visa fee wavier policy (effective from 
July 6, 2015 to Dec. 31, 2015) for group tourists from five countries (China, 
Vietnam, Indonesia, Philippines and Cambodia) following the MERS outbreak.
❍ The number of Chinese tourists to Korea fell sharply in the wake of 
the MERS outbreak this year. While it has shown signs of recovery 
since August, it still remains around 74% of the last year’s arrivals.
❍ In proactive support of attracting group tourists for the “2016 Visit 
Korea Year”, the Ministry of Justice came to an agreement to extend 
the current visa fee* waiver policy for group tourists to the end of 
2016. (*About USD 15 per person)
❍ The Ministry expects that the extended visa fee waiver policy would 
attract more group tourists from China and other countries and 
thereby significantly contribute to the revitalization of the Korean 
tourism industry and the economic recovery.

question: What happens to a real estate immigrant investor's status if they lease or sell the property?
reference: The investment status is cancelled and the alien registration is cancelled, so they cannot continue to stay.
answer: If a real estate immigrant investor leases or sells the estate, their status will be cancelled [1]. Consequently, they will not be able to continue their stay in Korea [2].

citations.title: Korea Investment Immigration Center Real Estate Investor Scheme Guide
citations.snippet:
Investment Guide for Investors for the Real 
Estate Immigrant Investor Scheme
This guide outlines relevant details for investors for the Immigrant Investor
Scheme for Real Estate.
A. (Maintaining Investment Status) Please be warned that your status will be
cancelled if you lease or sold the estate, or if your estate becomes foreclosed
or is set up for mortgage.
* If you, in any case, fail to meet any of the investment requirements during
your investment period, your alien registration will be cancelled, and you will not
be able to continue your stay in Korea.
B. (Working or Engaging in Economic Activities) When you have an investor
visa, you are free to work, study, and involve in economic activities,
however, you must not engage in any speculative behavior or sell or work
in an industry that hinders public good and custom.
C. (Re-entry Period) If you have done your alien registration already, you must
come to Korea at least once within one year from the date of departure,
otherwise, your alien registration will be cancelled.
D. (Extending the Period of Stay) You must come to Korea and get an extension
from an immigration office BEFORE your visa expires, otherwise, your alien
registration will be cancelled.
E. (Giving a Consent to the Use of Personal Information) Please note that, by
laws, all agents who sell their real estate properties to others must check the
lease status, mortgage, sale or foreclosure of their individual buyers and report
to the Immigration Office every May and November.
F. (Other Remarks) For more information, please check our website at
www.visa.go.kr or contact the Korea Investment Immigration Center (☏
032-740-7888, 7788) and your jurisdictional immigration office.
As a real estate investor, I, (Investor's name), hereby consent that I have read
and understood all of the information above, and I will abide by the rules.
20 . . .
Name (signature)
[별첨3(영문)]

question: For how long is a letter of attorney for a foreign investor's applications valid?
reference: 30 days from the day it is written (and it cannot be written while the mandator is outside Korea).
answer: A letter of attorney is only valid for 30 days from the day it is written [1].

부동산등 자산투자 외국인 사전심사안내 신청서
Application for Pre-investigation of Foreign Investor(Real estate, etc)
신청인
Applicant
성명 Full Name 여권번호(외국인등록번호)
Passport No.(Alien Registration No.)
주소 Address
투자대상
Investment Project
투자시설 Investment Facility 개발업체 또는 분양업체
Development enterprise or Selling-in-lots enterprise
투자시설 소재지 Address of Investment Facility
투자예정 금액 Amount of Planned Investment Money 부동산등 자산투자 외국인에 대한 체류관리지침의 규정에 따라 본인의 체류허가 적합여부에 대하여 
사전심사안내를 위와 같이 신청하며, 사후 사정변경 등으로 실제 체류허가 등 결정내용이 사전안내와 
다르더라도 이의를 제기하지 않겠습니다.
 Following regulations in sojourn administration guidelines of foreign investors, I request the pre-investigation 
of my sojourn suitability as it is written above, and will never raise objections even if the final decision is 
different from the result of pre-investigation due to condition changes in future.
Date: 년 YYYY 월 MM 일 DD장
 신청인 Applicant :
(서명 또는 인)
(Sign or stamp)
○○○출입국관리사무소장(출장소장) 귀하
To Chief, ○○○Immigration(Branch) Office
첨부 : 신분증사본 1부. (1 copy of ID card)
사 전 심 사 결 과
 事先审查结果 
 □ 적합 / □ 부적합 
 Approved Disapproved
확인자Confirmer (서명 또는 인)
(Sign or stamp)
유의사항 Matters to be attended to
1. 사전심사안내는 투자금액 등 투자요건을 갖추었을 경우 신청인에 대한 각종 체류허가 등 가능여부에 대하여 사전에 
확인해주는 것이며, 실제로 체류허가를 결정하는 것은 아닙니다. Pre-investigation is only for checking possibilities of various sojourn related businesses in advance when the applicant satisfies 
investment conditions such as investment money. It does not make an actual decision about sojourn related businesses.
 2. 사전심사안내를 받은 이후 국내법 위반 및 기타 사정변경 등이 있을 경우 실제 체류허가 등 신청 시에는 사전안내와 
다르게 결정될 수 있습니다.
 In case of violating domestic laws or other condition changes, your apply for sojourn related businesses can be decided in a different way other than pre-investigation.
210㎜×297㎜[일반용지(2급) 60g/㎡]

passages.title: Visa guide: D-8-1 Incorporated Enterprise
passages.snippet:
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A dispatch order indicating the period of a dispatch and a certificate of employment
③ A Foreign Investment Notification form or A copy of Certificate of FDI Company Registration
④ A copy of Business Registration Certificate, a copy of unabridged corporate registration, an original copy of a statement demonstrating the change of shareholders
⑤ Documents demonstrating a transfer of investment capitals
Case A. Investment in Cash
- A permission of a foreign currency transfer, or a confirmation of foreign currency remittance issued by the respective customs service or a bank (or a financial institution) of a respective country
- A statement of investment funds such as a confirmation of foreign currency transfer, a certificate of purchased foreign currency, a customs declaration form and others
Case B. Investment in Kind
- A copy of Confirmation of Completion of In-Kind Investment issued by the head of Korean Customs Service
- A copy of Customs Import Declaration Certificate
⑥ Additional documents for private investors who has invested less than 300 million KRW
- Documents demonstrating an initial capital such as a receipt for the purchased goods, costs of office interior, a bank statement
- Documents verifying the existence of business (i.e. an office lease contract, photos of an office in a front and an inside view, a street sign of a company or others)
- Documents proving work or entrepreneurial experiences from an applicant's country.

question: In the visa e-form on the Korea Visa Portal, how must the family name and given names be entered?
reference: In uppercase letters only; both are required fields.
answer: In the visa e-form on the Korea Visa Portal, the family name and given names must be entered in English as shown in the passport. The applicant must write these details in block letters either in English or Korean. If the applicant selects "Other" for any field, they must provide more information in the given space. question: Which authorities issue apostilles in Bulgaria?
reference: Two competent authorities - the Ministry of Justice (Sofia) and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (2 Alexander Zhendov Street, Sofia 1032).
answer: In Bulgaria, the Ministry of Justice issues apostilles for court and notary documents, while the Ministry of Foreign Affairs handles all other documents [1].

passages.title: Visa guide: F-1-15 Parents of Foreign Talents, etc
passages.snippet:
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are
A parent of a person satisfying the following requirements and a parent of the person's spouse
① (foreign talent) a Long-term News Coverage (D-5), Intra-Company Transferee (D-7), Corporate/Foreign Investor (D-8), International Trade (D-9), and from Professor (E-1) to Foreign National of Special Ability (E-7) visa holder whose annual income is twice per capita GNI of the previous year or more
- Including a person who has changed his/her status of stay to F-2, F-5, etc. while maintaining the same activities falling under the above statuses
- However, if you change your status of stay to the above statuses (D-5, D-7, D-8, D-9 or E-1 - E-7) after earning a bachelor's degree or higher in Korea, the minimum annual income requirement is lowered to per capita GNI of the previous year or more.
② (investor) a registered foreigner who has invested 300 million KRW in Korea and stayed in the country for 6 months or more in accordance with the Foreign Investment Promotion Act, the Foreign Exchange Transaction Act and the Immigrant Investor Scheme.
③ (student) a foreign student enrolled in a master's/doctoral program of Korea who has stayed in the country for 6 months or more

passages.title: Expansion of multiple entry visa issuance
passages.snippet:
- 1 -
□ The Ministry of Justice (Minister Park Sang-ki) announced that it will expand the 
eligibility for multiple entry visas starting from December 3, 2018 to revitalize 
people to people exchanges and to attract inbound tourists from the countries 
of New Southern Policy, by granting a multiple entry visa with validity of 10 
years to professionals such as doctors, lawyers, etc. in the region. 
○ The number of visitors between Korea and the countries of New Southern Policy is 
expected to surpass a record 10 million this year with the visitors from those 
countries to the ROK already rising 13.8% from the previous year as of 
end-October this year.
○ The Ministry has decided to expand the eligibility for multiple entry visas to provide 
expedited entry services to the nationals from the countries of New Southern Policy, 
and the measure comes at a time when inbound tourists from those countries under 
the President Moon’s new policy are steadily on the rise with the popularity of Hallyu 
(Korean Wave) such as K-POP, etc. 
□ Eligibility and details for the 10-year multiple visa issuance scheme are as follows.
 ○ A Short-Term General (C-3) multiple entry visa valid for 10 years will be granted, 
MOJ revises its visa rules to expand exchanges with countries of 
New Southern Policy

passages.title: The Ministry of Justice's Measures to Provide Convenient Entry to Foreign Tourists
passages.snippet:
- Exemption of Visa Application Fees for Group Tourists
- Extension of Visa Expiration Date
- Expansion of No-visa Entry
- ❍ The Ministry of Justice of the Republic of Korea has decided to implement proactive measures such as exemption of visa application fees in order to provide foreign tourists with easier and convenient access to Korea and thereby support the concerned tourism industry following the recent Middle East Respiratory Syndrome (MERS) outbreak.
- ❍ The measures include:
1. First, exemption of visa application fees for group tourists from China and other countries for three months (from July 6 to September 30)
- Visa application fees for Chinese group tourists (currently about 15 US dollars per person) are exempt for three months to support attracting foreign tourists.
- The same exemption measure applies to four Southeast Asian countries (Vietnam, Philippines, Indonesia and Cambodia) to which group tourist visas
are issued.

passages.title: (Press Release) Visa Fee Waiver Policy for Group Tourists during the“2016 Visit Korea Year”
passages.file_name: 151221 PRESS RELEASE(Visa Fee Waiver Policy for Group Tourists).pdf
passages.snippet:
- 1 -
❍ The Ministry of Justice of the Republic of Korea extends the current 
visa fee waiver policy for group tourists through to the end of next 
year by reflecting the opinions of the tourism industry and relevant 
authorities.
 Note: The Ministry has implemented visa fee wavier policy (effective from 
July 6, 2015 to Dec. 31, 2015) for group tourists from five countries (China, 
Vietnam, Indonesia, Philippines and Cambodia) following the MERS outbreak.
❍ The number of Chinese tourists to Korea fell sharply in the wake of 
the MERS outbreak this year. While it has shown signs of recovery 
since August, it still remains around 74% of the last year’s arrivals.
❍ In proactive support of attracting group tourists for the “2016 Visit 
Korea Year”, the Ministry of Justice came to an agreement to extend 
the current visa fee* waiver policy for group tourists to the end of 
2016. (*About USD 15 per person)
❍ The Ministry expects that the extended visa fee waiver policy would 
attract more group tourists from China and other countries and 
thereby significantly contribute to the revitalization of the Korean 
tourism industry and the economic recovery.

question: Who is eligible for the D-10-1 job seeker visa?
reference: Former employees (over 1 year in the last 3 years) of a Fortune Global 500 company; graduates in the last 3 years of a university in the Times Higher World University Rankings; graduates in the last 3 years of a Korean community college or higher; bachelor's holders who completed a research program at a Korean research institution in the last 3 years; and others specially acknowledged by the head of the diplomatic mission.
answer: You are eligible to apply for the D-10-1 Job Seeker visa if you meet one of the following criteria: * You are a previous employee of a listed company on Fortune's Global 500 companies for more than 1 year in recent 3 years [1]. * You are a graduate of a university listed on Times' Higher World University Rankings in recent 3 years [1]. * You are a graduate of a Korean community college or higher in recent 3 years [1]. * You have a bachelor's degree or above and completed a research program at a Korean research institution in recent 3 years [1]. * You are specially acknowledged by the head of diplomatic mission [1].

■ 출입국관리법 시행규칙 [별지 제19호의3서식] <신설 2014.10.29.>
(제1쪽 / Page1)
외국인 배우자의 결혼배경 진술서
(Personal Details Form for a Marriage Migrant Visa)
<유의사항>
 ‣ 이 진술서는 결혼동거 목적의 사증발급 또는 체류자격 변경허가를 받으려는 해당 외국인(신청인)이 작성합니다. 
 ‣ 원칙적으로 이 서류에 기재된 정보에 따라 심사가 진행되니 영사 및 출입국관리공무원이 심사에 참고할 수 있도록 
신청인께서는 해당하는 모든 질문에 답변하시고, 답변과 관련된 입증서류가 있는 경우 모두 제출하시기 바랍니다. 
 ‣ 해당하는 답변을 누락하거나 입증서류를 제출하지 않은 경우에는 심사가 지연되거나 불허될 수 있습니다.
 ‣ 만약 사증발급이나 체류자격 변경허가에 필요한 요건을 갖추지 못하였거나 요건을 입증하는 서류가 없음에도 거
짓된 사실을 기재하거나 위ㆍ변조된 서류를 제출하는 경우에는 관련 법령에 따라 처벌될 뿐만 아니라, 한국 입
국이 금지될 수 있습니다. 
 ‣ 요건을 갖추지 못하였거나 요건을 입증하는 서류가 없는 경우에는 그 사유를 기재한 사유서를 제출하여 주시기 
바랍니다. 
 ‣ 귀하께서 제공한 정보는 「개인정보 보호법」에 따라 보호되며, 다른 법령에 근거가 없는 한 출입국관리법에 따
른 업무에만 활용됩니다. <NOTICE>
 ‣ This form must be completed by a person who apply for a marriage migrant visa or a change of visa status.
 ‣ In principle, the evaluation of the visa application will be based on the information provided on this personal details form. 
 ‣ Therefore, the applicant should answer all questions to the best of his/her knowledge and submit relevant 
documentation in order for the consul or the immigration officer to use it as a reference. 
 ‣ If a necessary answer has been omitted or any relevant documentation has not been submitted, the application process may 
be delayed or result in a disapproval. 
 ‣ If conditions are not met for the visa or falsified information and/or documentation are forged to meet the conditions
required to receive the visa, you will be not only penalized under the relevant statute, but also banned from entering 
the Republic of Korea. 
 ‣ If you are unable to provide proper documentation, submit a statement stating the reason. 
 ‣ The information you provide in this form will be protected according to the Personal Information Protection Act, and 
will only be used for matters governed by the Immigration Act.

question: An F-6-1 applicant needs a letter of guarantee from the inviter. What is the longest guarantee period that letter can cover?
reference: The F-6-1 page lists a letter of guarantee from the inviter; the Letter of Guarantee form states the period of guarantee shall not exceed 4 years.
answer: The longest guarantee period for an F-6-1 applicant is 4 years.

passages.snippet:
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are
A citizen of a country that has signed a working holiday agreement or memorandum of understanding (MOU) with the Republic of Korea on the purpose of travel and finding a short-term employment to financially support yourself during the stay in ROK

passages.title: Visa guide: H-2-1 Work and Visit Family Connection
passages.snippet:
Overseas Korean aged 25 or older with foreign nationality defined in the 「Act on Immigration and Legal Status of Overseas Koreans」 who is applied to any of the followings:
1. A person who was Korean at the time of birth and has a Certificate of Family Registry, Certificate of Removal from Family Registry or closed Register
2. A person with a parent or grandparent who had nationality of Korea
3. A person who is invited by a Korean with a local address of residence in ROK, or a permanent resident(F-5-7) met the naturalization requirements defined in「Nationality Act」to be granted with the permanent residency (an inviting person and invitee must be in kinship closer than eighth degree if the two are related by the same ancestors, or closer than fourth degree if the two are related by marriage.)
4. A person of distinguished service to ROK and his/her (bereaved) family in accordance with the 「Act on the Honorable Treatment and Support of Persons, etc. of Distinguished Services to The State 」or 'a person of distinguished services to Independence, and his/her (bereaved) family' in accordance with the 「Act on the Honorable Treatment of Persons of Distinguished Service to Independence」
5. A person who has made a remarkable contribution to ROK, or who engaged in the promotion of national interests of ROK
